card: Adds BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to doc/bips.md. Bitcoin Core implemented this signing behavior in v0.17.0 (#13666), but the documentation omitted the formalized specification entry. This is a documentation-only update.
evidence: Commit d57346d682 and PR description note that Bitcoin Core implemented low-R grinding in PR #13666 (v0.17.0), which BIP 461 formalizes.
problem: doc/bips.md lacks an entry for BIP 461, leaving the list of BIPs implemented by Bitcoin Core incomplete.

risk.why: It is a one-line markdown documentation change with no code or behavior impact.

summary: Adds BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to the list of implemented BIPs in doc/bips.md. Bitcoin Core has implemented this behavior since v0.17.0 via PR #13666.
